name: Aviation Practice
blurb: Practice training-document verification, passenger assistance handoffs, and simulator evidence review.

rounds.title: Aviation Operations Trainee: Escalate a Briefing Version Conflict
rounds.focus: Keep a document check honest and obtain the approved training briefing without inferring operational readiness.

rounds.title: Ground Operations Coordinator: Preserve an Agreed Assistance Handoff
rounds.focus: Maintain passenger choice and a confirmed assistance owner during a changed departure arrangement.

rounds.title: Aviation Safety Analyst: Reconcile a Simulator Debrief Timeline
